limitations: Static qualification does not certify actual external upload; final readback/download receipts required
SDK/CLI import/dependency graph and credential behavior are not independently executed or exhaustively qualified
Ordinary-file hash fences detect mutations but do not impose kernel filesystem immutability
The strict old identity check includes.gitattributes; automatic Hub changes would fail verification rather than qualify preservation

resolved_draft_finding.resolution: Exact prepared-tree review schema, repo/prefix/parent/count required; all review artifact records must be closed bytes/SHA maps for ordinary absolute non-symlink files and rehash exact. Exact map membership required for preparation receipt,3208-identity baseline and all103 upload paths. Incidental hash strings no longer qualify.

scope: Static publisher source qualification only. No execution, network, models, tests, numerical or resource work. Actual payload prepared-tree qualification is a separate required gate, not conferred by this review.

statically_verified_controls.authority: Publishes custom experimental4checkpoint states and evidence only; no legal semantics/Lake/default promotion or numerical replay inferred.
statically_verified_controls.failure: Exclusive receipts, created commit receipt saved before readback/download; failures stop without automatic retry. Partial created commit must be reconciled before another explicit attempt.
statically_verified_controls.mutation: Sole create_commit with CommitOperationAdd under newprefix and exact parent_commit compare-and-swap. Live baseline Git/LFS identity map must match all3208 files; prefix absent. No delete/card/default operations.
statically_verified_controls.readback: Immutable created revision; every old identity exact and precisely103 new paths. CLI hf download uses exact created revision/newprefix, then each103 downloaded byte/SHA and original local pin verified.
statically_verified_controls.tree: All ordinary files exactly equal receipt pathset; no symlinks; every relative path remains within fixed newprefix, no parent traversal; all local file pins exact
